partners.mechanism_chain: EIF4A3 (HGNC:3561) —DISRUPTS→ mRNA export and nuclear pore complex integrity; NUP107 (HGNC:8002) —DISRUPTS→ mRNA export and nuclear pore complex integrity; mRNA export and nuclear pore complex integrity —LEADS_TO→ Cerebellar hypoplasia (HP:0001346); mRNA export and nuclear pore complex integrity —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); mRNA export and nuclear pore complex integrity —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250); mRNA export and nuclear pore complex integrity —LEADS_TO→ Nephrotic syndrome (HP:0000103). Mutations in EIF4A3 and NUP107 disrupt the integrity and function of the nuclear pore complex and associated mRNA export pathways. #### 1. Galloway-Mowat syndrome 7  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.449)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-1169408, Reactome:R-HSA-159236)

**Proposed mechanism:** EIF4A3 (HGNC:3561) —DISRUPTS→ mRNA export and nuclear pore complex integrity; NUP107 (HGNC:8002) —DISRUPTS→ mRNA export and nuclear pore complex integrity; mRNA export and nuclear pore complex integrity —LEADS_TO→ Cerebellar hypoplasia (HP:0001346); mRNA export and nuclear pore complex integrity —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); mRNA export and nuclear pore complex integrity —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250); mRNA export and nuclear pore complex integrity —LEADS_TO→ Nephrotic syndrome (HP:0000103). Mutations in EIF4A3 and NUP107 disrupt the integrity and function of the nuclear pore complex and associated mRNA export pathways. This disruption leads to a cascade of downstream effects, including cerebellar hypoplasia, intellectual disability, seizures, and nephrotic syndrome, which are characteristic phenotypes of both Richieri Costa-Pereira syndrome and Galloway-Mowat syndrome 7.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in EIF4A3 or NUP107 in affected individuals with either disease that do not segregate with the phenotype, or demonstration that the affected pathways in the two diseases are entirely distinct despite the shared genes. _(variant: Presence of common benign variants (AF > 0.01) in EIF4A3 or NUP107 in GnomAD that are associated with the disease phenotypes.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanistic basis involving EIF4A3 and NUP107 in these syndromes could pave the way for developing targeted therapies that address the common downstream consequences, potentially benefiting patients with either condition.
